summary: A fast wheeled scout with a heavy machine gun and room for a squad. It sees far, shreds infantry and light vehicles, and carries its passengers into the fight with their weapons ready.

sections.title: Heavy machine gun
sections.how: Select the Kozak and left-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The heavy machine gun fires quick bursts. It tears through infantry, scouts and other light vehicles, and can answer low drones. Against a main battle tank it struggles badly.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select one or more infantry, then left-click your own Kozak.
sections.body: A squad rides hidden inside and cannot be selected until the riders get out. If the Kozak is destroyed, everyone aboard dies with it.

sections.title: Fire from inside
sections.how: Load infantry into the Kozak and drive close to the enemy; the passengers fire on their own.
sections.body: The Kozak has firing ports, so its passengers shoot from inside with their own weapons instead of standing in the open. They stay hidden and untargetable while they ride.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded Kozak and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Kozak and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Kozak drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Use its sight to find the enemy first: the Kozak spots further than it shoots.
Load a squad before driving into the open so the passengers keep firing from inside.
Do not lead with it: let tanks take the hits while the Kozak hunts infantry and light vehicles.
